parsed.notes: Lens B found no treatment/currency defect in the assertions as framed. The major disclosed risk is that treatment and progeny remain intentionally unverified.

reasons: The lake identity record matches the asserted case name, court, year, and docket.
The lake citation fields select and display 606 U.S. 942 as the official citation.
The disclosed treatment/progeny fields contain no adverse overruling, abrogation, supersession, or limitation edge.
residual_risks: The lake record marks treatment as unverified and progeny not derived, so current citator status beyond the disclosed record remains unresolved.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the page's unverified-treatment banner until citator/progeny verification is completed.

reasons: Support placement is outside lens B except for currency/treatment defects.
The content page frontmatter lists [[Suing Federal Officers]] with role Recent development.
No disclosed treatment/progeny edge contradicts this role.
residual_risks: No disclosed policy defines how long Recent development remains current.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: If Recent development is time-limited, add an explicit review or expiry date.

reasons: Holding support is lens A territory; lens B identifies no adverse treatment defect in the disclosed record.
The page expressly labels treatment as unverified, matching the lake treatment status.
No disclosed progeny or treatment edge supersedes or limits the stated holding.
residual_risks: Because treatment/progeny are unverified, later limiting authority cannot be excluded from the disclosed files alone.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Avoid presenting the holding as citator-verified until treatment is promoted from unverified.

reasons: The content page treatment fields match the lake record: field_i_validity unverified, composite_basis unverified, null as-of fields, varies_by_point false, and the same frontier-stub scope note.
The lake treatment edges and point_overrides arrays are empty, and progeny enumeration is not derived.
The page's visible Treatment & subsequent history section accurately warns that subsequent treatment is not yet machine-verified.
residual_risks: This is an intentionally unverified treatment state, not a current good-law certification.

reasons: The authority-weight label Binding — SCOTUS matches the disclosed court and court_level fields, both scotus.
The lake citation record identifies the selected official U.S. Reports citation for a Supreme Court case.
No disclosed treatment field or progeny edge supplies a reason to downgrade the jurisdictional weight label.
residual_risks: The binding-weight label is jurisdictional; it should not be read as a verified good-law treatment status while treatment remains unverified.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Visually keep authority weight distinct from treatment status so Binding — SCOTUS is not mistaken for a citator result.
